_comment: Three shipped fixes, each pinned by an input that fails when the bug comes back. ZK008 appears twice because there are two dedupe loops with the same hole: one note names its broken target in the frontmatter and again in ## Links, the other names a body-only target twice in one Links section. ZK011 and ZK006 both land on permanent/index.md, which is a note the orphan check used to skip by filename while the filename check still reported it. ZK024 fires on the note with a real unmarked paragraph and stays silent on the note whose long line is a numbered list item, so the fix is calibrated in both directions rather than by absence.
